The base Fist upgrade (die d6, loses nonlethal, gains modular B/P/S) is hardcoded in derive.ts as `fistDieUpgraded` = powerful-fist / warrior-automaton / warrior-jotunborn only; no data field upgrades the built-in Fist profile, and grantedStrikes would add a SECOND fist row instead of replacing it (an over-grant).

fix.note: Needs the fist-upgrade lane in derive.ts (FIST_PROFILE / fistDieUpgraded) to be data-driven — a record field that raises the Fist die, removes nonlethal, and adds the modular trait.

Adds Illusory Disguise, Illusory Object and Illusory Scene to the druid's spell list as primal spells — a real expansion of what the player may prepare, but the spell picker offers only the tradition list and no field adds specific spells to it.

fix.note: No spell-list-addition lane exists: innateSpells would wrongly make them at-will innate casts, and effectChoices/spellFilter only PICKS a spell. Needs a field that widens a caster entry's selectable list with named spell ids.

records.reason: Grants Light and Ghost Sound as primal innate cantrips and the record carries no innateSpells, so the sprite never gets them on the Spells page.

fix.note: Only the two unconditional cantrips are granted; the grig heritage's Detect Magic (and the draxie's, whose spell the record's text drops entirely) are heritage-gated and would be an over-grant here.

The record's text grants an extra cantrip per day (four instead of three, five instead of four at 4th level) and nothing delivers it: cantripsKnown() is a hardcoded per-class number and spellSlotBonus explicitly skips rank 0 (build.ts `r > 0`).

fix.note: No lane raises the CANTRIP count. spellSlotBonus.byRank ignores rank 0 and cantripsKnown(classId) is hardcoded in spellcasting.ts, so the same gap blocks Cantrip Expansion. Needs a cantrip-count bonus field the builder's cantripCap reads.
